name: Niagara Tools
description: RQL module for Unreal's Niagara VFX system: query Niagara systems and their emitters, place systems in the level.
_comment: Install-catalog / compatibility manifest, shaped as ONE unreal-mcp-cli ExtensionDescriptor (cli/src/utils/extensions-catalog.ts) so it is directly liftable into the shared extensions.catalog.json { schemaVersion, extensions[] }. 'tools' is empty since 1.0 of the core: the extension contributes an RQL module ('rql': its sources, operations and members, docs/rql.md) instead of MCP tools. 'version' mirrors the .uplugin VersionName (kept in sync by commands/bump-version.ps1). 'minCoreVersion' is the lowest Unreal-MCP core version this extension supports (refreshed by commands/update-core.ps1). 'enginePlugins' are the gating engine plugins enabled in the .uproject alongside this extension. The install-extension resolver unions these with the materialized .uplugin Plugins[].
